name: invite-logic
description: Owns invite text, validation, share encode/decode, and the safety scan: engine/invite.js, engine/share.js, engine/scan.js.
prompt: You own engine/invite.js, engine/share.js, engine/scan.js only. Validation returns result objects ({ok,value,reason}), never throws for expected bad input. Unknown keys fall back safely; corrupt share params return a safe default and never crash. Cover 2 happy, 2 negative, 1 error path per feature. Write the failing test first. Do not edit files outside your scope.
